name: ^observabilityTicketSchema\.safeParse$
reason: zod applies the schema declared beside the call; replay checks the decoded ticket and the twin branches only on its answer.

name: ^CardText$
reason: Chat SDK card text element constructor; the twin compares the text it hands it and passes the element on.

name: ^uploadSlackFiles$
reason: The Chat SDK Slack adapter performs the files.uploadV2 calls; the twin compares the uploads and options it hands over.

name: ^github\.postMessage$
reason: The Chat SDK GitHub adapter posts the comment through the GitHub REST API; the twin compares the thread and markdown it is given.

name: ^client\.close$
reason: The Convex SDK client closes its own subscription socket; the twin checks that every plane client is closed.

name: ^slack\.getUser$
reason: The Chat SDK Slack adapter looks the user up through the Slack API; the twin compares the user id and picks the name from the row it returns.
